Multiple Bus Accidents Across India Result in Fatalities

Several bus accidents have been reported across different parts of India, leading to multiple fatalities and injuries. Incidents include a bus crashing into a trailer and catching fire in Rajasthan, a bus hitting a scooter in Telangana, and another bus colliding with a building in Kerala. The accidents highlight ongoing road safety concerns.
